Here are some reliable places to buy **makeup online with delivery in Saudi Arabia (KSA)**:

## Beauty retailers (focused on makeup/beauty)
- **Sephora Middle East (Saudi store)** – prestige makeup, skincare, fragrance (ships in KSA). ([sephora.me](https://www.sephora.me/sa-en?___store=sa_ar&utm_source=openai))  
- **FACES KSA** – major regional beauty retailer with a strong makeup selection and KSA online store. ([faces.sa](https://www.faces.sa/en?utm_source=openai))  
- **Nice One KSA** – large Saudi beauty e-commerce store covering makeup + lots of personal care. ([niceonesa.com](https://niceonesa.com/en/all-products?page=4%2F&utm_source=openai))  
- **Golden Scent** – well-known in KSA for perfumes and also carries beauty products; has KSA delivery info in their help pages. ([goldenscent.com](https://www.goldenscent.com/en/?utm_source=openai))  

## General marketplaces (good selection, but check the seller)
- **noon (KSA)** – big selection and fast delivery options; since it’s a marketplace, check that the item is **sold by noon / official store** and review authenticity notes. ([noon.com](https://www.noon.com/saudi-en/beauty/makeup-16142/?utm_source=openai))  

If you tell me **your city (e.g., Riyadh/Jeddah/Dammam)** and whether you want **luxury (Dior, Huda Beauty, etc.)** or **drugstore (Maybelline, L’Oréal, etc.)**, I can narrow it to the best 2–3 options and what to watch for (returns, authenticity, delivery speed).
